title: Schedule a Pod on a Tainted Node
prompt:
Node `node02` carries the taint `cka-arena/practice=critical:NoSchedule`. Deployment `web` in namespace `cka-wl-taint` is pinned to `node02`, so its Pod stays `Pending`.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Make the Pod of Deployment `web` schedulable on `node02`.
2. Keep the Pod pinned to `node02` via its existing nodeSelector.

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: cka-wl-taint
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        kubernetes.io/hostname: node02
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine

checks.description: Pod of Deployment `web` is Running and Ready
checks.failure_hint: Add a toleration for key cka-arena/practice, value critical, effect NoSchedule.
Do not remove the nodeSelector; add a toleration instead.

reference_solution:
Add the matching toleration.
```bash
kubectl -n cka-wl-taint patch deployment web --type=merge -p='{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"tolerations":[{"key":"cka-arena/practice","operator":"Equal","value":"critical","effect":"NoSchedule"}]}}}}'
```
hints: Inspect node taints (`k describe nodes | grep -i taint`) and pending pod events in `cka-wl-taint`.
Add the matching `tolerations` entry (`key`, `operator`, `value`, `effect`) to Deployment `web` pod template.
